pages.text: Tinker's Anvil no longer uses the old button GUI. Sneak-right-click the required heated input stack into the anvil, then right-click the anvil with a hammer. The anvil will progress the selected CraftTweaker recipe directly.
If multiple recipes match the same input, sneak-right-click with a hammer to cycle the selected output. JEI only shows anvil recipes that were added by CraftTweaker scripts.
